# 👩👦🧓 Contributors

Please find below the list of contributors (a few of them chose to remain anonymous, so their names aren't displayed). Some contributors are active ocean observers and photographers – check out their social media accounts for more ocean stories, photos, and videos.


```{r, echo = FALSE}

participants <- read.csv("airtable/participants.csv")
knitr::kable(participants,
             escape = FALSE,
             col.names = c("Participant", "Their social media")
)
```

PS: I am currently finishing to compile the observations I have received – apologies if your name isn't yet displayed in the list. Your name should appear there by December 2026.

# 🐟 Fish species reported so far
Below is a list of species reported to be able to use rocks as tools by contributors. There are already so many species on the list. How many more will we discover?

Find more information about the fishes by following the links to FishBase, Wikipedia, or DORIS (in French), and more photos by following the links to iNaturalist. 

```{r}
#| results: asis
#| echo: false

fish <- read.csv("airtable/fish.csv")
fish$filename <- paste0("fish-pictures/", fish$filename)
fish <- fish[with(fish, order(Species)),]

cat('<div class="fish-grid">\n')

has_link <- function(x) !is.na(x) & nzchar(trimws(x))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(fish))) {
  links <- sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank">FishBase</a>',
                   fish$Link.Fishbase[i])
  if (has_link(fish$Link.Wikipedia[i])) {
    links <- paste0(links, '\n·\n',
                    sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank">Wikipedia</a>',
                            fish$Link.Wikipedia[i]))
  }
  if (has_link(fish$Link.Doris[i])) {
    links <- paste0(links, '\n·\n',
                    sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank">Doris</a>',
                            fish$Link.Doris[i]))
  }
  if (has_link(fish$Link.iNaturalist[i])) {
    links <- paste0(links, '\n·\n',
                    sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank">iNaturalist</a>',
                            fish$Link.iNaturalist[i]))
  }

  cat(sprintf(
    '<div class="fish-card">
<img src="%s" alt="%s">
<div class="fish-species">%s</div>
<div class="fish-common">%s</div>
<div class="fish-links">
%s
</div>
</div>\n',
fish$filename[i],
fish$Species[i],
fish$Species[i],
fish$Vernacular.name[i],
links
  ))
}

cat('</div>\n')
```
